spec.name: hermes_traffoflex_tokenlane_patterns
spec.purpose: Closed learning loop with skill creation from experience and on-demand session recall, affiliate postback normalisation and weighted routing shape, and RWA plan-and-receipt discipline, all restated in our own words

summary: Patterns from NousResearch/hermes-agent (MIT), devflex-pro/traffo-flex (MIT) and talocode/tokenlane (MIT): a closed learning loop where a completed complex task is summarised into a plain-text skill file (approach, edge cases, domain knowledge) that self-improves during later use, session history kept in a full-text index and searched on demand instead of loaded whole, and a small curated persistent profile that loads every session; an affiliate registry shape (campaign/stream/destination/traffic-source/postback-template) with weighted destination selection, trafficback, postback normalisation plus deduplication plus outbound postback log, and traffic/conversion/revenue/cost/profit/ROI reports; and an RWA plan-and-receipt discipline where a plan is an asset record or a list of failed fields, a per-kind per-jurisdiction questionnaire asks questions and gives no legal answers, a representation spec marked spec_only names hooks without compiling them, an oracle reference is stored and never called, and a receipt id is issued per plan with a failed check returning the error and never pretending issuance. All restated in our own words, stdlib-only, no provider/network/API-key/server/MCP/GPU/model-weight/payment code.
